name: rag-eval-llmops
description: RAG system over the FastAPI docs with an evaluation framework: a 50-question golden dataset, hand-written retrieval metrics (Recall@k, MRR), Ragas for faithfulness and relevance, and per-query token and latency tracking. Experiments compare chunking, top-k and hybrid search. Built with Python, Gemini, sentence-transformers and ChromaDB.
